title: Mutuality helps you recognise proportion
meaning: Gentle action motivated by mutuality is emotionally answered by a sense of proportionate participation and acknowledged consequences.
text: Strength in the physical position of this Energy Field describes shared actions in which a powerful impulse does not become forceful pressure. The Lovers in energy give a motive to seek living mutual involvement and remain turned towards each other. Justice in emotions adds sensitivity to the proportion of contributions and consequences. The overall tone can therefore combine a wish for closeness with satisfaction that a particular decision recognises each person’s actual circumstances, including different resources and degrees of convenience.

For example, you choose concert tickets, but the preferred seats cost too much for one person. Instead of arguing insistently, you calmly discuss alternatives because attending together through mutual willingness matters. Affordable seats bring relief. **Being beside you feels good when participation does not ask one person to pay a disproportionate price.** Emotional clarity concerns this specific distribution of burden, rather than an overall judgement of either person’s worth.

A difficulty appears if the feeling of fairness becomes the only response allowed from the other person. One considers the compromise proportionate while the other remains disappointed about the option lost. Gentleness may then end in a demand for gratitude. Justice in emotions does not prove that the calculation is infallible. The Lovers as motivation likewise do not mean that wanting to be together removes the right to experience an agreed decision differently.
